title: kbs wiki search (list exists in 0.19.1, not in 0.14.0)
description:
Researcher first-pass on /workspace/research-pod, kbs 4151343 (release 0.14.0).

CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md documents `kbs wiki list`. That command does not exist on 0.14.0 (only wiki render). It does exist on Homebrew kbs 0.19.1.

Need:
- `kbs wiki search <query>` to maintain a research wiki (list alone is not enough).
- Agents on older kbs should be told to upgrade, or list must be backported in docs as a version-gated command.

Do not treat missing list on 0.14.0 as a develop regression.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Shipped in Kanbus 0.20.0 via PR #172 (list/search/show/lint/check/init, render path, short issue.key, references()). Closing.
